step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates a data ingestion and analytics pipeline for manufacturing sites. IoT data is ingested via AWS IoT Core into Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. AWS Lambda processes this data and routes it to Amazon Elasticsearch Service for visualization, Amazon DynamoDB for persistent storage, and Amazon S3 as raw JSON. AWS Glue performs transformation jobs on S3 data, which is queried using Amazon Athena. Results are exposed through Amazon API Gateway to end users.
